review.body:
Reviewed exact head `2596cefa89d311e4fc153ce1fee6dc6079291ffd`. SECURITY-N/A.

This matches the maintainer-approved direction in #140: when an executable is made runnable, the owner must retain read permission even under a restrictive umask. The patch preserves the existing execute-bit behavior and adds only `S_IRUSR`; its focused tests cover both the normal `0o022 -> 0o755` case and the reported restrictive `0o777 -> 0o511` case, including a real POSIX chmod check. The head CI run is green. Current `main` has advanced, but the intervening changes do not touch `src/installer/utils.py` or this behavior, and the PR remains mergeable. I found no correctness, readability, architecture, security, or performance blocker on this head. LGTM.
